claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase { kind: "unconditional" }
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Heal is an action-cast spell that applies its effect directly to a target — no attack roll, no saving throw. The current ActivationPhase union only has 'attack_roll' and 'save_gate' variants. A third variant is needed for spells that unconditionally deliver their effect on cast (no resolution gate).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a creature that you can see within range. Positive energy washes through the target, restoring 70 Hit Points.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: HealHpEffect in spell Effect union
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell Effect type is currently 'DamageEffect | NoneEffect'. Heal's primary mechanic is healing HP. HealHpEffect already exists as a ClassFeatureEffect but is not available in the spell Effect union. It must be promoted (or duplicated) to the spell side.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Positive energy washes through the target, restoring 70 Hit Points.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: RemoveConditionEffect in spell Effect union
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Heal ends three conditions (Blinded, Deafened, Poisoned) on the target. The v4 atom 'remove_condition' exists in the taxonomy but there is no surface Effect variant for it. A RemoveConditionEffect type with a conditions array is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This spell also ends the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions on the target.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: FlatAmount scalar in DiceAmount (or DiceExpr with dice=0)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Heal restores a flat 70 HP with a flat +10 per slot level above 6 — no dice at all. DiceExpr requires dice and dieSize fields, so a flat-only amount must be represented as { dice: 0, dieSize: 0, flat: 70 }, which is semantically misleading. A dedicated 'flat' DiceAmount variant would be cleaner, though this is lower priority than the phase/effect gaps above.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: restoring 70 Hit Points [...] The healing increases by 10 for each spell slot level above 6.
